note: Monster types (M5, ADR 0010). Stats are design guesses; the behaviour follows Book 1. Spawns (M5.2) are design guesses: where Erin meets them in Book 1, placed on our small maps.

canon_ref.note: Goblins hunt in small groups with knives and stones, and run when they lose.
It looks like a boulder, rushes out with big claws, and gives up the chase quickly.
A dino-bird that nests in the long grass and pecks hard to guard its eggs.
An armoured Goblin leader with a bow and blades. He hunts Erin for revenge and fights to the death. Only in a canon stage (M6.5), never in a spawn.
A Goblin a head taller than the rest, not yet a Hob, with a short sword. Leads the raid on the inn on day 21. Only in a canon stage, never in a spawn.

One of three Human adventurers with swords and armour who try to kill the Goblins in the inn on day 28, then run from Gazi. Only in a canon stage, never in a spawn. Design: they run early (flee_below) because canon has them run, not die.
The biggest of the three, with an axe; he holds off three Antinium at once. Only in a canon stage, never in a spawn. His danger is above the others, so the fight's records name him.

Leads a feathered Goblin tribe on the Floodplains: nearly twice a Goblin's size, heavyset, in patched rusty armour, with an axe. The small band's leader burns him with a spell. Only in a canon stage, never in a spawn.
Rotting dead that sense the living and run at them to bite and claw. Under Skinner they sprint (1.60). Only in a canon stage (M7.4), never in a spawn.
Armed undead bones that fight with swords, daggers and maces, some with bows. Only in a canon stage (M7.4), never in a spawn.
The advanced form of a zombie: fast, strong, leaps and claws; a knife in the skull does not stop it. Only in a canon stage (M7.4), never in a spawn.

A huge thinking undead of fused corpse flesh with bone teeth and clustered eyes; commands lesser dead and spits poison black blood. Menes: fight it at about Level 22-26. Only in a canon stage (M7.4), never in a spawn.

The guardian of the Ruins of Liscor: a red worm that lives inside a legless hide of stolen skins, flays with a touch and freezes the living with fear from its red eyes. Pisces: not undead. Design: no fear aura yet; it fights to the end. Only in a canon stage (M7.4), never in a spawn.
A Worker of Erin's chess club, strong but clumsy, armed with whatever it found. Only a stage helper on the player's side (M7.4), never hostile, never in a spawn.
A huge Antinium Soldier with spade-like hands that tears the dead apart and ignores fear. Only a stage helper on the player's side (M7.4), never hostile, never in a spawn.

The half-Gazer Named Adventurer, one of the King of Destruction's Seven. She sees every blow coming, guards only her head, and her armor turns arrows. Design: she cannot die on the map; hurt badly, she steps through her teleport portal (escape). Only in a canon stage (M8.1), never in a spawn.

escape.line: Gazi stops smiling. She backs into her spinning portal, and it swallows her.

canon_ref.note: Drake and Gnoll guardsmen with spears and bows; twenty hold the Ruins entrance after the siege. Only a stage helper on the player's side (M8.1), never hostile, never in a spawn.

Shopkeepers, artisans and a tavern owner of Krshia's tribe with great war bows, out for blood. Only a stage helper on the player's side (M8.1), never hostile, never in a spawn. Helpers fight in melee; bows are not modelled.
Armed Silverfang Gnoll warriors of Brunkr's war party, sword and shield. Only in the M8.3 inn-battle canon stage, never in a spawn.
Three golems of packed snow that attack Erin and Toren on her sledge trip; they fall apart when beaten, leaving a core of cold snow. Only in the M8.7 snow-golem canon stage, never in a spawn.

Three men with knives who wait in a Celum alley for the marks a boy lures in; one is an ex-Bronze-rank adventurer. Only in the M8.7 Celum-mugger canon stage, never in a spawn. Design: they run when hurt.

Five drunk adventurers of the Brilliant Swords of Celum (four Bronze-rank, one Silver-rank) who start a brawl in the Frenzied Hare. Only in the M8.7 bar-fight canon stage, never in a spawn. Design: drunk, so slow and easy to hit.
Regular drinkers of the Frenzied Hare who join Erin, Ryoka and Garia against the Brilliant Swords. Only a stage helper on the player's side (M8.7), never hostile, never in a spawn.

The Celum Runner, newly made a Courier, fast with [Double Step] but not yet Level 20. She trips Ryoka in the guild and loses the fight that follows. Only in the M9.1 Runners' Guild canon stage, never in a spawn. Design: she cannot die on the map; beaten, she runs out of the guild (escape).

escape.line: Persua staggers to the door, nose bleeding, and swears she will kill the Runner girl. Then she is gone in a double step.

canon_ref.note: Runners of the Celum guild who side with Persua; one grabs Ivolethe and asks for a ransom. Only in the M9.1 Runners' Guild canon stage, never in a spawn. Design: street-level fighters who run when hurt.

spawns.note: A Rock Crab lies among the rocks by the blue fruit valley (1.01).
Goblins come for the blue fruit in the morning (1.02).
Goblins raid the inn after dark while their Chieftain lives (1.02-1.14).
A Razorbeak guards its nest in the long grass (1.05).
Design: once the Watch stops patrolling near the inn (1.30), monsters creep closer, as Pisces and Selys warn (1.34). Which ones is not shown yet; a Rock Crab by the hill's rocks stands in.
